rfc-dns.title: RFC 1034: Domain Names - Concepts and Facilities

alternating-current.short_definition: Alternating current changes direction periodically and usually changes magnitude with time.

accuracy.short_definition: Accuracy is the fraction of all predictions that a classification model gets correct.

active-low.short_definition: An active-low signal performs its named action when the signal is at logic low.

algorithm.short_definition: An algorithm is a finite, ordered procedure for solving a problem or completing a task.

analog-input.short_definition: An analog input converts a voltage within an allowed range into a numerical reading.

and-gate.short_definition: An AND gate outputs 1 only when every input is 1.

array.short_definition: An array stores an ordered collection of values that are accessed by position or index.

attention.short_definition: Attention lets a neural network assign different weights to information when producing a representation or prediction.

authentication.short_definition: Authentication is the process of verifying the identity of a user, device, or service.

back-emf.short_definition: Back EMF is a voltage induced in a coil that opposes the change in current that produced it.

backpropagation.short_definition: Backpropagation efficiently computes how each neural-network parameter contributes to prediction error.

baseline-model.short_definition: A baseline model is a simple reference result used to judge whether a more complex model adds useful performance.

bigram.short_definition: A bigram is an ordered pair of adjacent tokens used in a two-token language model.

bill-of-materials.short_definition: A bill of materials is a structured list of the parts, quantities, and identifying details needed for a build.

binary-number-system.short_definition: The binary number system represents values with powers of two and the digits 0 and 1.

bios.short_definition: BIOS is older PC firmware that initializes hardware and starts the operating-system boot process.

boolean-algebra.short_definition: Boolean algebra describes logical values and operations such as NOT, AND, and OR.

branch-git.short_definition: A Git branch is a named line of development whose tip advances as new commits are added.

breadboard.short_definition: A solderless breadboard provides reusable connected rows and power rails for prototyping circuits.

capacitor.short_definition: A capacitor stores energy in an electric field between conductors separated by an insulator.

circuit-breaker.short_definition: A circuit breaker opens a circuit when current exceeds a safe condition and can normally be reset.

classification.short_definition: Classification is a machine-learning task that predicts which category or class an example belongs to.

class-imbalance.short_definition: Class imbalance occurs when some target classes have many more examples than others.

client.short_definition: A client is a program or device that requests a service from a server.

closed-loop-control.short_definition: Closed-loop control uses measured output feedback to adjust the controller's action.

clustering.short_definition: Clustering groups examples by similarity without requiring known class labels.

computer-numerical-control.short_definition: Computer numerical control coordinates machine motion from programmed commands.

combinational-logic.short_definition: Combinational logic produces outputs determined only by the current input values.

git-commit.short_definition: A Git commit records a project state together with identifying information and links to its parent history.

confusion-matrix.short_definition: A confusion matrix counts predicted classes against actual classes so different error types remain visible.

control-system.short_definition: A control system directs a process or machine so its output follows an intended behaviour.

cron.short_definition: Cron is a Unix-style scheduler that runs commands at configured dates or repeating times.

cross-validation.short_definition: Cross-validation repeatedly changes which data subset is held out so model performance can be estimated more reliably.

current-divider.short_definition: A current divider is a parallel network in which branch current depends on branch resistance or impedance.

data-leakage.short_definition: Data leakage lets information unavailable at prediction time influence model training or evaluation.

data-logging.short_definition: Data logging records measurements with time, units, and enough metadata to interpret the results later.

data-type.short_definition: A data type defines the kind of value a program can store and the operations allowed on it.

direct-current.short_definition: Direct current maintains one direction of charge flow, even if its magnitude changes.

debouncing.short_definition: Debouncing prevents the rapid transitions of a mechanical contact from being counted as multiple intended events.

decision-tree.short_definition: A decision tree makes predictions by following learned feature tests through branches to an output.

decimal-number-system.short_definition: The decimal number system represents values with powers of ten and the digits 0 through 9.

desoldering.short_definition: Desoldering removes solder so a connection or component can be separated without avoidable damage.

dynamic-host-configuration-protocol.short_definition: DHCP supplies network configuration, such as an IP address and lease time, to a client.

digital-logic-level.short_definition: A digital logic level is a voltage range interpreted as low, high, or indeterminate by a digital input.

domain-name-system.short_definition: The Domain Name System maps hierarchical names to resource records such as IP addresses.

electrostatic-discharge.short_definition: Electrostatic discharge is a sudden transfer of static charge that can damage electronic components.

embedding.short_definition: An embedding is a learned vector representation in which useful relationships can appear as geometric proximity.

engineering-notation.short_definition: Engineering notation uses powers of ten whose exponents are multiples of three.

ensemble-model.short_definition: An ensemble combines predictions from multiple models to produce a final result.

equivalent-resistance.short_definition: Equivalent resistance is the single resistance that has the same terminal voltage-current behaviour as a resistor network.

exception.short_definition: An exception is a program event that interrupts normal execution when an error or unusual condition occurs.

explainability.short_definition: Explainability concerns how people can understand the evidence and reasoning behind a model's behaviour.

fairness-machine-learning.short_definition: Machine-learning fairness examines whether a system's outcomes or errors create unjustified differences across people or groups.

feedback.short_definition: Feedback returns information about a system's output to influence its future input or control action.

filesystem.short_definition: A filesystem organizes stored data into files, directories, names, and associated metadata.

floating-input.short_definition: A floating input is not held at a defined logic voltage and may change state unpredictably.

flyback-diode.short_definition: A flyback diode provides a safe current path when an inductive load is switched off.

footprint-pcb.short_definition: A PCB footprint defines the pads, holes, outline, and placement information for a physical component.

full-adder.short_definition: A full adder adds two input bits and a carry-in to produce a sum bit and carry-out.

function-programming.short_definition: A function is a named, reusable block of code that can accept inputs and return a result.

fuse.short_definition: A fuse opens a circuit by melting its element when excessive current persists.

gerber-file.short_definition: A Gerber file describes one manufactured PCB layer for fabrication and inspection.

general-purpose-input-output.short_definition: A GPIO pin is a configurable digital connection used by a controller to read or drive external circuits.

gradient.short_definition: A gradient collects the rates at which a function changes with respect to its parameters.

grounding-ai.short_definition: Grounding connects generated claims to selected evidence, data, or observable system state.

guess-method.short_definition: The GUESS method organizes a calculation as Given, Unknown, Equation, Substitute, and Solve.

half-adder.short_definition: A half adder adds two input bits to produce a sum bit and a carry bit.

hallucination-ai.short_definition: An AI hallucination is generated content presented without adequate support from reliable evidence.

hexadecimal-number-system.short_definition: The hexadecimal number system represents values with powers of sixteen and the symbols 0 through 9 and A through F.

hysteresis.short_definition: Hysteresis uses different switching thresholds for rising and falling values to prevent rapid chatter.

inductor.short_definition: An inductor stores energy in a magnetic field and opposes changes in current.

internal-pull-up.short_definition: An internal pull-up is a controller's built-in resistor that weakly holds an input high when no device pulls it low.

safety-interlock.short_definition: A safety interlock permits operation only when required protective conditions are satisfied.

internal-resistance.short_definition: Internal resistance models voltage loss and heating inside a source when it supplies current.

interrupt.short_definition: An interrupt pauses normal program flow so a designated routine can respond to an event.

ip-address.short_definition: An IP address identifies an interface for delivering packets within an Internet Protocol network.

karnaugh-map.short_definition: A Karnaugh map arranges truth-table values so adjacent groups can reveal a simpler Boolean expression.

kernel.short_definition: A kernel is the operating-system core that manages hardware resources and provides services to programs.

kirchhoffs-current-law.short_definition: Kirchhoff's current law states that the algebraic sum of currents at a node is zero.

kirchhoffs-voltage-law.short_definition: Kirchhoff's voltage law states that the algebraic sum of voltage changes around a closed loop is zero.

language-model.short_definition: A language model assigns probabilities to token sequences and can predict tokens from context.

least-privilege.short_definition: Least privilege gives each user or process only the permissions needed for its approved task.

light-dependent-resistor.short_definition: A light-dependent resistor changes resistance as the light reaching it changes.

linear-regression.short_definition: Linear regression fits a linear relationship between input features and a numerical target.

linux-distribution.short_definition: A Linux distribution packages the Linux kernel with system tools, applications, and an update method.

loading-effect.short_definition: Loading occurs when a connected circuit changes the voltage or current that an earlier circuit would produce by itself.

logic-gate.short_definition: A logic gate implements a Boolean operation on one or more digital inputs.

loop-programming.short_definition: A loop repeats a block of instructions while a condition or sequence controls the repetition.

loss-function.short_definition: A loss function produces a numerical penalty that measures how far predictions are from desired results.

mac-address.short_definition: A MAC address is a link-layer identifier used to deliver frames on a local network segment.

machine-learning-bias.short_definition: Machine-learning bias is a systematic tendency in data, modelling, or evaluation that distorts a system's results.

maximum-power-transfer.short_definition: Maximum power transfer occurs at a load condition that receives the greatest available power from a source network.

measurement-uncertainty.short_definition: Measurement uncertainty describes the reasonable range around a measured result caused by instrument and method limits.

metric-prefix.short_definition: A metric prefix scales an SI unit by a named power of ten, such as milli, kilo, or mega.

microcontroller.short_definition: A microcontroller combines a processor, memory, and programmable input-output hardware on one integrated circuit.

mount-filesystem.short_definition: To mount a filesystem is to attach it at a directory so its files become accessible.

digital-multimeter.short_definition: A digital multimeter measures quantities such as voltage, current, resistance, and continuity when connected in the correct mode.

nand-gate.short_definition: A NAND gate outputs the inverse of AND, so it outputs 0 only when every input is 1.

neural-network.short_definition: A neural network is a layered model that learns parameterized transformations from examples.

ngram.short_definition: An n-gram is an ordered sequence of n adjacent tokens used to model local patterns.

nor-gate.short_definition: A NOR gate outputs the inverse of OR, so it outputs 1 only when every input is 0.

norton-equivalent.short_definition: A Norton equivalent represents a linear two-terminal network as an ideal current source in parallel with a resistance.

not-gate.short_definition: A NOT gate outputs the opposite logic value from its input.

open-loop-control.short_definition: Open-loop control applies a command without using measured output to correct the action.

operating-system.short_definition: An operating system manages computer resources and provides services and interfaces for applications and users.

operational-amplifier.short_definition: An operational amplifier is a high-gain differential amplifier commonly used with feedback to perform analog functions.

or-gate.short_definition: An OR gate outputs 1 when at least one input is 1.

overfitting.short_definition: Overfitting occurs when a model fits training data so specifically that it performs poorly on new examples.

package-manager.short_definition: A package manager installs, removes, and updates software from configured package sources while tracking dependencies.

parallel-circuit.short_definition: A parallel circuit connects branches across the same two nodes, so each branch has the same voltage.

disk-partition.short_definition: A disk partition is a defined region of a storage device that can be managed as a separate logical area.

printed-circuit-board.short_definition: A printed circuit board mechanically supports components and connects them with patterned conductive layers.

perfboard.short_definition: Perfboard is a perforated prototyping board used to solder components and hand-wire a permanent circuit.

file-permissions.short_definition: File permissions control which users may read, modify, or execute a file or access a directory.

pid-control.short_definition: PID control combines proportional, integral, and derivative responses to the control error.

ping.short_definition: Ping tests reachability and round-trip response using Internet Control Message Protocol echo messages.

pipe-shell.short_definition: A shell pipeline connects the output of one command to the input of the next command.

port-network.short_definition: A network port number identifies a transport-layer endpoint used by an application or service.

power-on-self-test.short_definition: A power-on self-test is firmware's initial check of essential hardware during startup.

potentiometer.short_definition: A potentiometer is a three-terminal adjustable resistor commonly used as a variable voltage divider.

precision-metric.short_definition: Precision is the fraction of positive predictions that are actually positive.

process-computing.short_definition: A process is a running instance of a program with its own execution state and assigned resources.

prompt.short_definition: A prompt is the input instruction and context supplied to a generative model.

proportional-control.short_definition: Proportional control makes controller output change in proportion to the current error.

network-protocol.short_definition: A network protocol defines rules and message formats that communicating systems follow.

pseudocode.short_definition: Pseudocode expresses an algorithm in structured plain language without requiring a programming language's exact syntax.

pull-down-resistor.short_definition: A pull-down resistor weakly connects an input to ground so the un-driven state is a defined logic low.

pull-up-resistor.short_definition: A pull-up resistor weakly holds an input high while a grounded switch can pull it low when pressed.

pulse-width-modulation.short_definition: Pulse-width modulation controls average delivered output by changing the fraction of each cycle spent on.

recall.short_definition: Recall is the fraction of actual positive examples that a classifier correctly identifies.

recommendation-system.short_definition: A recommendation system selects and ranks items that may be useful or relevant to a user or context.

rectifier.short_definition: A rectifier uses directional devices such as diodes to convert alternating current into one-directional output.

redirection-shell.short_definition: Shell redirection changes where a command reads input or sends output and error streams.

relay.short_definition: A relay uses an electrically controlled actuator to open or close one or more separate contacts.

residual.short_definition: A residual is the difference between an observed target value and the value predicted by a model.

retrieval-augmented-generation.short_definition: Retrieval-augmented generation supplies selected external information to a generative model as context for its response.

sampling-language-model.short_definition: Language-model sampling chooses an output token from a probability distribution rather than always taking only the top choice.

circuit-schematic.short_definition: A circuit schematic uses standardized symbols and nets to show electrical relationships rather than physical layout.

scientific-notation.short_definition: Scientific notation writes a value as a coefficient from 1 up to 10 multiplied by a power of ten.

sequential-logic.short_definition: Sequential logic produces outputs from current inputs together with stored state from earlier events.

serial-communication.short_definition: Serial communication transfers data as an ordered stream of bits over one or a small number of signal paths.

series-circuit.short_definition: A series circuit places components in one current path, so the same current passes through each component.

server.short_definition: A server is a program or device that provides a service in response to client requests.

service-linux.short_definition: A system service is a managed background program that provides an operating-system or network function.

setpoint.short_definition: A setpoint is the target value that a control system tries to make its measured output follow.

command-shell.short_definition: A command shell reads commands, expands their arguments, and starts programs or built-in operations.

significant-figures.short_definition: Significant figures communicate which digits in a measured or calculated value carry meaningful precision.

soldering.short_definition: Soldering joins conductors by heating the connection and flowing a lower-melting filler metal into it.

solenoid.short_definition: A solenoid converts electrical current in a coil into a magnetic field and usually linear mechanical motion.

secure-shell.short_definition: Secure Shell provides authenticated, confidential remote login and related services over an untrusted network.

state-machine.short_definition: A state machine models behaviour as named states and event-driven transitions between them.

strain-relief.short_definition: Strain relief transfers pulling and bending forces away from an electrical termination.

structured-output.short_definition: Structured output follows a defined machine-readable shape such as a table, record, or schema-constrained object.

test-dataset.short_definition: A test dataset is held back from model selection and used for a final estimate of performance on unseen examples.

thevenin-equivalent.short_definition: A Thevenin equivalent represents a linear two-terminal network as an ideal voltage source in series with a resistance.

three-five-five-timer.short_definition: A 555 timer is an integrated circuit used to create timed pulses, delays, and oscillations with external components.

threshold-classification.short_definition: A classification threshold converts a model score or probability into a class decision.

time-constant.short_definition: A time constant characterizes how quickly a first-order circuit rises or falls after a change.

tmux.short_definition: tmux is a terminal multiplexer that manages persistent terminal sessions containing multiple windows and panes.

token.short_definition: A token is one discrete unit of text representation processed by a language model.

tokenization.short_definition: Tokenization converts text into a sequence of tokens according to a defined vocabulary and procedure.

traceroute.short_definition: Traceroute estimates the sequence of network hops toward a destination by eliciting time-exceeded responses.

training-dataset.short_definition: A training dataset contains examples used to adjust a model's parameters.

transformer-model.short_definition: A Transformer is a neural-network architecture built around attention and position-aware token representations.

transistor-switch.short_definition: A transistor switch uses a smaller control signal to place a transistor in off or conducting operation for a load.

truth-table.short_definition: A truth table lists every input combination in binary order and records each output in its own column.

unified-extensible-firmware-interface.short_definition: UEFI is a modern firmware interface that initializes hardware and provides services for starting an operating system.

unsupervised-learning.short_definition: Unsupervised learning seeks patterns or representations in data without target labels for each example.

validation-dataset.short_definition: A validation dataset is separate from training data and supports model selection and tuning before final testing.

variable-programming.short_definition: A variable is a named reference used by a program to access a value that may change.

voltage-divider.short_definition: A voltage divider uses series impedances to produce an output that is a fraction of the input voltage.

voltage-regulator.short_definition: A voltage regulator maintains an output voltage within limits as input or load conditions change.

xnor-gate.short_definition: An XNOR gate outputs 1 when its compared inputs have the same logic value.

amplifier.short_definition: An amplifier uses energy from a source to produce an output signal that follows an input with increased voltage, current, or power.

astable-multivibrator.short_definition: An astable multivibrator switches repeatedly between two states without requiring an external trigger for each cycle.

bipolar-junction-transistor.short_definition: A bipolar junction transistor is a three-terminal semiconductor device in which base current controls a larger collector current.

feature-machine-learning.short_definition: A machine-learning feature is an input variable supplied to a model for training or prediction.

gain.short_definition: Gain is the ratio of an output signal quantity to the corresponding input signal quantity.

label-machine-learning.short_definition: A machine-learning label is the target answer associated with a supervised training example.

monostable-multivibrator.short_definition: A monostable multivibrator has one stable state and produces a timed pulse when triggered.

power-supply-unit.short_definition: A computer power supply unit converts input power into regulated outputs for the computer's components.

rectification.short_definition: Rectification is the process of converting alternating current into a one-directional electrical output.

smoothing-filter.short_definition: A smoothing filter reduces ripple or rapid variation in a rectified or regulated output.

xor-gate.short_definition: An XOR gate outputs 1 when its compared inputs have different logic values.
